label: Campaign launch at the Ashby Ford bandstand
note: Two hundred people, a borrowed microphone and the first printed copy of the plan.

label: Ballot filing deadline for county races
note: Candidates file with the county clerk. The ballot order is drawn the following week.

label: Wrenfield Ledger candidate forum
note: All three District 2 candidates on one stage at Hollin Cross High School.

label: Voter registration deadline
note: Last day to register by mail or online for the April 6 election. Same-day registration is available at early voting.

label: Early voting opens
note: At the county building in Marrow, weekdays 8 am to 6 pm and the two Saturdays before the election.

label: Early voting ends
note: The last Saturday, 9 am to 3 pm.

label: Election Day
note: Polls are open 7 am to 8 pm at your precinct's polling place.
